note: Episode 1 movement, decoded from record 5010 (terrain-type table + TerrainInfo tilesets). types[tileId] = Map::getTileType; rows[type] = the move cost per movement class [fly, skirmish, formation, cavalry, engine] that Map::getMoveCost reads (0 -> 1, 100 = impassable); links[type] = the only neighbouring types a ground unit may step between for that type (Map::isMoveAllowed: terrain rows longer than 10 fields). def[type] = the tile defence Map::getTileDefense returns (damage taken there, %: 80 = 20% cover, 110 = 10% extra); heal[type] = HP healed on it each turn (field 6).
